tooltip.tlm_beyond_space.spacetime_rescu: Right-click air: configure rescue mode for each task
Use on a maid: overwrite her settings with this book
Sneak-use: reset every maid's rescue options to Forbidden
tooltip.tlm_beyond_space.maid_weapon_cas: Small and light, yet made to carry the edge entrusted by her master.
When the rescue signal sounds: shadow falls, sheath opens, steel sings—
and the first sword-flower guards you.
In an inventory, right-click an item to store it; right-click an empty slot to retrieve it
tooltip.tlm_beyond_space.distress_signal: Sneak-use: maid roster; use: call for help
